columns.target_H: DEM ground height at the target (NAVD88 m)
columns.target_src: index into dem_sources of the raster that supplied target_H
columns.k_crit: [point, lamp] refraction coefficient above which the lamp is visible
columns.lim_s: [point, lamp] distance from the viewer of the limiting terrain sample (m)
columns.lim_src: [point, lamp] DEM source index of the limiting sample
columns.geo_el: [point, lamp] chord elevation at the eye (deg)
columns.clr: [point, lamp, k] clearance of the ray over the terrain (m, <0 = blocked)
columns.dL: [point, lamp, k] lamp-height change that flips visibility (m; <0: margin to spare)
columns.dE: [point, lamp, k] eye-height change that flips visibility (m; <0: margin to spare)
columns.kc_clutter: [point, lamp, clutter] k_crit with clutter m added to terrain >10 m from both ends
columns.p_vis: [point, lamp, k] Monte Carlo probability of visibility (terrain + eye-height errors)
